verdict.rationale: Aleph documents a built-in Aleph Agent that users can delegate work to. It pulls data across systems and reasons through analysis, keeps context across follow-ups, and can update existing reports and dashboards or build new ones from scratch. Specialized AI agents also run variance analysis (Scan) and monitor and suggest data mappings. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and in-depth first-party documentation of the agent's task scope, limits and how delegated actions are executed beyond marketing-page claims.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Have Aleph Agent update your existing reports and dashboards or start building new ones from scratch.
Aleph agent pulls data from across your systems, reasons through analysis, and returns a precise answer that you can trust and trace.
Ask a follow-up, and it already has the context.
Meet Scan, your AI analyst that runs flux and variance analysis in seconds
agents monitor your source data 24/7, ensuring new accounts, vendors, and dimensions are properly mapped
